import itertools
from public_contract import valid_history

def brute(req):
    txs = req['transactions']; n=len(txs)
    for perm in itertools.permutations(range(n)):
        rank={i:r for r,i in enumerate(perm)}
        good=True
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                if txs[i]['end'] <= txs[j]['start'] and rank[i] >= rank[j]:
                    good=False;break
            if not good: break
        if not good: continue
        order=[txs[i]['id'] for i in perm]
        if valid_history(req, order):
            return order
    return None
